description:
Enhanced fork of Hangfire.Redis.StackExchange. Hangfire Redis Storage Based on Redis.StackExchange.
      Original upstream project: https://github.com/marcoCasamento/Hangfire.Redis.StackExchange (no longer maintained).
      ✨ New Features:
      - Add SkipRequeueOnTimeout option to avoid duplicate jobs when worker process killed
      - Redis dirty‑key WRONGTYPE error defensive protection, log warning instead of crash storage
      - Improve resilience for Redis disconnect / failover scenarios
      - Fix production critical bugs from original 1.8.24 version.
      适用于 .NET / .NET Core / ABP vNext，解决进程被杀任务重复执行、Redis脏键导致后台服务崩溃问题.
      Namespace keep same as original, easy to migrate: uninstall old package, install this enhanced version.
      Main project: http://hangfire.io/
releaseNotes:
2.0.0 — Production-Ready Release / 生产就绪版本
      基于 1.12.0 全面重构，包含 17 项 P0/P1 Bug 修复、事务原子性保障、全链路 NRE 加固、294 个测试用例 100% 覆盖。向后完全兼容，建议所有生产环境升级。
      Full rebased from 1.12.0 with 17 P0/P1 bug fixes, transaction atomicity guarantee, full-pipeline NRE hardening and 294 test cases 100% coverage. Fully backward compatible. Production upgrade recommended.
      - Bug Fix #153: RemoveFromQueue Lua 脚本兼容性修复 / RemoveFromQueue Lua script compatibility fix
      - Bug Fix #154: HashEntry null 值导致任务无法入队 / HashEntry null value causes job enqueue failure
      - Bug Fix #159: Redis 故障转移时 Fetcher 静默僵死 / Fetcher silent stall during Redis failover
      - Bug Fix #160: FetchedJobsWatcher 超时回收无日志 / FetchedJobsWatcher timeout retrieval without logging
      - Bug Fix #161: 多可用区部署拉取负载不均衡（Jitter）/ Imbalanced fetch load in multi-AZ deployment (Jitter)
      - Bug Fix #162: Dashboard Awaiting 页面 WRONGTYPE 崩溃 / Dashboard Awaiting page WRONGTYPE crash
      - Bug Fix #163: RedisLock 锁续期死循环 + Timer 异常崩溃 / RedisLock renewal dead loop + Timer crash
      - Bug Fix #164: RedisWriteOnlyTransaction 事务原子性破坏 / Transaction atomicity broken in RedisWriteOnlyTransaction
      - Bug Fix #165: RedisConnection null NRE + GetStatistics Parse 崩溃 / RedisConnection null NRE + GetStatistics parse crash
      - Bug Fix #166: 全面代码审核 — 剩余 NRE/崩溃风险加固 / Full code audit — remaining NRE/crash risk hardening
      - Bug Fix #167: 测试整合与全面验证（208 用例全通过）/ Test consolidation and full validation (208 cases all passed)
      - Bug Fix #168: ListTrim/ListRemove 事务原子性 + 日志路径优化 / ListTrim/ListRemove transaction atomicity + log path optimization
      - Bug Fix #169: FetchNextJob HashSet 纳入重试逻辑 + 任务回滚机制（防止任务永久丢失）/ FetchNextJob HashSet included in retry + job rollback mechanism (prevent permanent job loss)
      - Bug Fix #170: [ThreadStatic] Random 种子唯一化（Interlocked.Increment）/ [ThreadStatic] Random seed uniqueness (Interlocked.Increment)
      - Bug Fix #171: SetRangeInHash 异常捕获保护 + 参数校验 / SetRangeInHash exception protection + parameter validation
      - Bug Fix #172: GetJobData Redis 异常防护（返回 null 而非崩溃）/ GetJobData Redis exception protection (return null instead of crash)
      - Bug Fix #173: AnnounceServer/RemoveServer 非事务分支日志统一 / AnnounceServer/RemoveServer non-transaction branch logging unified
      - Bug Fix #174: GetAllItemsFromSet/GetSetContains 修复错用 SortedSetScan（改用 SetMembers/SetContains）/ GetAllItemsFromSet/GetSetContains fix wrong SortedSetScan usage (use SetMembers/SetContains)
      - Bug Fix #175: FetchedJobsWatcher 队列级异常隔离 + 作业级异常隔离 / FetchedJobsWatcher queue-level + job-level exception isolation
      - Bug Fix #176: RedisMonitoringApi 全链路 key 类型检查（防止 Dashboard 500 崩溃）/ RedisMonitoringApi full-pipeline key type check (prevent Dashboard 500 crash)
      1.12.0
      - Fix #153 and all the changes / 修复 #153 及所有变更
      - Resume all changes after 1.9.3, realigning the codegit / 恢复 1.9.3 之后的所有变更，重新对齐代码
      - Bump Hangfire to 1.8.12 and StackExchange.Redis to 2.7.33 / 升级 Hangfire 至 1.8.12，StackExchange.Redis 至 2.7.33
      1.11.0
      - Fix #157 and bring back the code from 1.9.4 / 修复 #157，恢复 1.9.4 代码
      With this release I'm trying to start back from 1.9.4 (Latest release "approved for production" as 1.9.5 got unlisted) and I'm willing to review and recommit the code from there. One commit after the other.
      本版本尝试从 1.9.4 重新开始（1.9.5 已被取消发布，1.9.4 为最新"生产可用"版本），将逐步审查并重新提交代码。
      If anyone can help with testing, please drop a line to marco.casamento@gmail.com
      如有测试协助，请联系 marco.casamento@gmail.com
